records.title: Born
records.summary: Horror film in which Mary Elizabeth, a 21-year-old virgin, wakes up impossibly pregnant and is progressively possessed by her demon fetus. IMDb's parents guide records a scene in which a man has sex with her while she is pregnant, from behind and then with her on top; JoBlo's review describes the same scene as rough sex with the pregnant, possessed woman. She has no children before the story (a virgin at 21); there is no couple, as the sex partner is a one-off victim. Ending: her father tries to abort the baby, the CG demon fetus overpowers him and closes her womb, so whether she remains pregnant at the end is not clearly stated.
